test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: We, on an individual basis, can help to reduce the production of waste by following certain practices. Which of the following will however cause increase in waste?

options.text: Using cloth or jute bags for shopping
Using tin foil, plastic wraps, paper towels and plastic zip bags

solution:
The correct answer is __**Using tin foil, plastic wraps, paper towels, and plastic zip bags.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Decreasing and adopting a **more waste-free lifestyle** is one of the most crucial things we can do to help the **environment**.
 
• **Waste is a problem on many different levels.**
 
• The fact that it **pollutes the environment and depletes our planet's limited resources** are perhaps the two most glaring.
 
• **Using things like tin foil, plastic wrap, paper towels, and plastic zip bags results in more waste.**
 
• **Ways to reduce waste:**
 
 
• For refreshments on the go, use a reusable bottle or cup.
 
• **Use reusable shopping bags** for more than just groceries.
 
• **Recycle and make smart purchases.**
 
• Avoid serving food and beverages in single-use containers.
 
• Buy used products and donate your old ones.
 
• **Buy in bulk and at local farmers' markets to reduce packaging.**
 
• Reduce your consumption of paper for periodicals, receipts, and mail.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **4R of Recycling**

 
 
• **REDUCE:** This refers to** utilizing environmental resources **in a **sustainable manner and avoiding waste.** For instance, taking a bath with a bucket of water rather than a shower.
 
• **REUSE**: This indicates that we can put anything to multiple uses. Consider **repurposing a polythene bag for several uses.**
 
• **RECYCLE**: This refers to the processing and possible conversion of materials into other products that allow for their reuse. Paper, for instance, is recycled.
 
• **RECOVER**: This indicates that a **safe and environmentally friendly substitute** should be employed in its place. Using a clothes bag as opposed to a plastic bag is one illustration.
